Australia Invests $500 Million in Indian Infrastructure

AustralianSuper, the country's largest pension fund, has invested an additional $500 million in India's National Investment and Infrastructure Fund (NIIF). This investment is on top of the $240 million committed seven years ago. The move aims to support India's infrastructure development and diversify its investments abroad.
